SPECIFICATION & FORMULA

Calculation Methodology

LTV = (ARPU × Gross Margin %) / Monthly Churn Rate. LTV:CAC Ratio = LTV / CAC. CAC Payback Months = CAC / (ARPU × Gross Margin %).

REFERENCE BASIS: Standard Industry Financial & Technical Formula • ASSUMPTIONS MODEL: 2026-10-27

Reference Notes & FAQ

What is a healthy LTV:CAC ratio for a SaaS business?

A benchmark LTV:CAC ratio of 3:1 or higher indicates sustainable unit economics, while a CAC payback period under 6–12 months is ideal for bootstrapped founders.

How does reducing churn from 5% to 2.5% impact LTV?

Cutting monthly churn in half doubles average customer lifespan (from 20 months to 40 months) and doubles Customer Lifetime Value.
